# fptcloud_object_storage_iam_role (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fptcloud_object_storage_iam_user" "example" {
  vpc_id      = "your_vpc_id"
  region_name = "your_region_name"
  user_name   = "app-backend"
}

# trusted_users is who may assume the role. It is replaced as a whole on every
# update, and a name the account cannot resolve is dropped by the API rather
# than rejected - so only name users that exist, or the plan will never settle.
resource "fptcloud_object_storage_iam_role" "example" {
  vpc_id      = "your_vpc_id"
  region_name = "your_region_name"
  role_name   = "read-only"

  trusted_users = [
    fptcloud_object_storage_iam_user.example.user_name,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region_name` (String) The region name that's are the same with the region name in the S3 service. Currently, we have: HCM-01, HCM-02, HN-01, HN-02
- `role_name` (String) Name of the IAM role. The API has no rename, so changing it replaces the role
- `vpc_id` (String) The VPC ID

### Optional

- `trusted_users` (Set of String) Names of the IAM users allowed to assume this role. A set, because the trust policy holds principals in its own order. An update replaces the whole list, and a name the account cannot resolve is dropped by the API rather than rejected - such a name will show as permanent drift until it is removed from the configuration or the user is created

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The IAM role ARN
- `created_at` (String) When the IAM role was created
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `path` (String) The IAM role path
- `role_id` (String) The IAM role ID assigned by the storage platform
